none: PAS NLM-19322D: Early Medieval Coin: Penny of Cnut
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Silver coin. Penny of Cnut (1016-1035), cf. Spink (2004) no. 1158. The coin was presented in two unequal parts, one cleaned and one of an uncleaned rusty tint. A further part of the cleaned section broke away under examination. Obverse description: Bust draped and helmeted left with sceptre before face. Obverse inscription: CNVT REX AN[?G].
